## Stat.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `label` :: A short caption above the value, such as "Monthly recurring revenue".
- `value` :: The figure to display. A number is formatted with `format`; a string is shown as written.
- `delta` :: A signed change, shown beside the value with a trend icon.
- `deltaAs` :: How to read `delta`: a percentage point figure (`4.2` → "+4.2%") or an absolute number.
- `trend` :: The trend direction. Inferred from the sign of `delta` when omitted.
- `tone` :: The colour of the delta. Inferred from the trend when omitted.
- `hint` :: A quiet footnote under the value, such as "vs last month".
- `icon` :: An icon drawn beside the block.
- `countUp` :: Springs the numeric value from zero when the stat first scrolls into view.
- `format` :: `Intl.NumberFormat` options used when `value` is a number.
- `locale` :: The locale passed to `Intl.NumberFormat`. Defaults to the runtime locale.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the figure.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the label, the delta and the hint.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the label, the hint and the icon.
- `iconTextSize` :: The scale of the icon beside the block.
